newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen soft on lack of news.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen soft on lack of news.

text.p: Jakarta shares price are expected to be soft on Thursday due to the lack of positive news with some investors seen continuing a recent wave of profit-taking, brokers said.
"Some investors will trade on a short-term basis because they are preparing for a series of Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) in December," a foreign broker said.
Brokers and analysts said generally all IPOs in 1996 were successful and investors would look to make gains in the six offers scheduled for next month.
Brokers said some positive news, including generally positive nine-month results from noodle maker Indofood and cement maker Indocement were likely to lift sentiment on the issues.

"But I don't think it could lift overall market sentiment as keystone stocks such as Telkom were not traded in New York due to the Thanksgiving holiday," a foreign analyst said. On Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index had fallen 8.77 points, or 1.41 percent to close at 611.50 points.
